sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
Heard Sri Sudhiar Kumar Agarwal, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned AGA.

This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 29.10.2022 in Case Crime No. 260 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 307 IPC and 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Muzaffar Nagar.

Learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents submitted that the charge-sheet no. 3/23 has been filed on 1.1.2023 in the present case and as such, the cause for filing present writ petition no more survives.
In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
